items.title: Why are the 11th and 12th centuries seen as a period of transition in Indian history?
items.explanation: The 11th and 12th centuries mark a transition because they saw the end of Arab invasions that had little impact on India, followed by deeper penetration by Turkic powers like the Ghaznavids. This shift involved new powers emerging with distinct economic, military, and administrative systems, while native kingdoms like the Hindu Shāhis successfully resisted these invaders.

items.title: What high accomplishments in art, architecture, literature, science, etc., do we come across during this period?
items.explanation: During this period, many Indian rulers flourished by conducting naval expeditions, creating astonishing monuments, and projecting India's influence abroad. Notable figures include poets, philosophers, saints, and scientists whose works continue to illuminate us today.
